strategy.name: Pine · Daily TSMOM rebalance
strategy.description: Completed daily 20/60/120/252 votes, point-volatility sizing, and a rebalance at the first 15-minute close of each Globex session.
strategy.migration_scope: Historical Pine decision/timing port. Daily bars and signal use the selected futures dataset, not a separate signal symbol or TradingView settlement feed. Whole contracts; no TradingView margin-call emulation. Live request.security repaint behavior is not reproduced.

evaluation.hypothesis: Original frozen 2022 selections for all nine NQ strategies; no retuning. 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-31, 243 calendar days. September is only a partial month.
